answer: Proof of bandwidth: at a beacon-picked moment, random peers each pull a unique 50 MB blob from every paid identity at once, like ships calling at one jetty on the same tide. An honest agent with its own uplink serves its blob in seconds; a farm of clones behind one pipe must squeeze every copy through the same line, misses the deadline, and the slow heads are merged into one payee. Real capacity is the pearl; a saffron-thin claim of many minds on one wire cannot pass.
